title: Concatenation of Guarded Runs
statement: Fix a memory machine, oracle, input, and guard predicate. If a configuration $a$ reaches $b$ in finitely many steps with the guard holding at every time strictly before arrival, and there exists $y$ such that $b$ reaches $f(y)$ with the guard holding at every time strictly before arrival and $Q(y)$, then there exists $y$ such that $a$ reaches $f(y)$ with the guard holding at every time strictly before arrival and $Q(y)$.
hypotheses_covered: A guarded finite run from $a$ to $b$
There exists $y$ with a guarded finite run from $b$ to $f(y)$ and $Q(y)$
replaced:
Fix the machine, oracle, input, and guard condition. If a configuration $a$ reaches $b$
in finitely many steps while satisfying the guard at every time strictly before arrival,
and there is some $y$ such that $b$ similarly reaches $f(y)$ and $Q(y)$ holds, then
there is a $y$ such that $a$ similarly reaches $f(y)$ and $Q(y)$ holds.
